question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Hurdle
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obstacle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hurdle** means a a problem that you have to deal with before you can make progress.

 
 
• ***Example *-** *He won a medal in the high **hurdles**.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Obstacle** means a thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress.
 
 
• ***Example*-** *He overcame the **obstacles** of poverty and neglect.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Hurdle'** and '**Obstacle'** are **similar in meaning.**
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rudiment **means a basic principle or element or a fundamental skill.
 
• **Compliment** means a polite expression of praise or admiration.
 
• **Assistance** means the action of helping someone by sharing work.
